preset-help: A lens is a named set of weights: a starting point, not a standard. Every lens is listed below, and moving any slider makes the weights your own.
weights-help: A weight multiplies a factor's effect on a street's score. Factors marked “helps” push a score up and “hurts” push it down; the bar under each slider is that factor's average effect on a street right now.
severity-help: At 100% a severe problem counts more than a minor one, as the engine does. At 0% every problem counts the same.
tags: Use tag adjustments (e.g. a curb ramp tagged steep counts less)
min-completion: Minimum completion to show a score
min-completion-help: Neighborhoods explored less than this are hatched instead of scored, so a score never rests on a few streets.
updated-at: Scores reflect labels clustered on {{date}}. Labels added since then are folded in nightly.
updated-never: Scores will appear after the first nightly clustering run.
view-labelmap: See the labels on the Label Map
tip-standout-feature-better: Stands out: {{type}} helps more here ({{value}} per street vs {{city}} citywide)
tip-standout-feature-worse: Stands out: {{type}} helps less here ({{value}} per street vs {{city}} citywide)
tip-standout-problem-better: Stands out: {{type}} costs less here ({{value}} per street vs {{city}} citywide)
tip-standout-problem-worse: Stands out: {{type}} costs more here ({{value}} per street vs {{city}} citywide)
show-labels: Show the labels behind the scores
show-labels-help: Labels appear once you zoom in to street level. Click one to see it in the imagery.
